name: Desktop Tools
description: Agent-facing tools over Neon Pilot's own Windowed OS desktop.

tools.name: desktop_control
tools.title: Desktop Control
tools.description: Control Neon Pilot's own Windowed OS desktop by opening apps/routes and focusing, moving, resizing, snapping, minimizing, restoring, or closing windows by semantic id.
promptGuidelines: Call desktop_state first, then use window ids or app ids from the semantic state/registry rather than guessing.
Use this only for Neon Pilot's own Windowed OS desktop. It is not host-OS computer use and does not inspect pixels.
Commands are acknowledged by the renderer after it applies the same window actions available to the user.

tools.name: desktop_screenshot
tools.title: Desktop Screenshot
tools.description: Capture Neon Pilot's own Windowed OS desktop, or one visible desktop window by semantic window id, as a PNG image.
promptGuidelines: Call desktop_state first, then pass a windowId from the semantic state when you need a specific window.
Use this only for Neon Pilot's own Windowed OS renderer. It is not host-OS computer use and does not capture other Mac windows.
If a target window is minimized or missing, use desktop_control to restore or focus it before retrying.

tools.name: desktop_state
tools.title: Desktop State
tools.description: Read the current semantic Windowed OS desktop state: windows, routes, focus, bounds, z-order, parent windows, workspace cwd, and route metadata.
promptGuidelines: Use this before controlling or inspecting Neon Pilot's own desktop. It is read-only semantic state, not a screenshot or host-OS computer-use capture.

tools.name: desktop_window_events
tools.title: Desktop Window Events
tools.description: Read recent user action events on agent-touched windows: focus, minimize, restore, close, move, resize, maximize, and snap actions the user has taken since the agent last read events.
promptGuidelines: Use the returned event id as lastEventId on subsequent calls to incrementally read new events without reprocessing old ones.
Events have a bounded buffer (max 100); old events are evicted. Call frequently enough to avoid gaps.
This is a request-response read of past user actions, not a live stream. For real-time awareness, poll this tool periodically.

lastEventId.description: Return only events after this event id. Omit to get the most recent events.
